title: Ecosystem Prospectivity Probe: prioritized signal fusion for emergent model monitoring
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable lightweight probe that fuses public signals (model announcements, license changes, benchmark releases), telemetry (customer latency and error spikes), and pricing/availability indicators into a single prospectivity index for prioritizing which emerging open models and providers Redwood should track or onboard. Deliver a prototype dashboard and a prioritized watchlist for mid-market and enterprise customers with reasoning and suggested mitigations.
background: We get frequent incoming signals about new open models, weights, quantized variants, and vendor moves. The existing scouting is manual and biased toward large entrants. Product, GTM, and infra need an operational score to allocate limited model-onboarding and compatibility testing bandwidth. This ticket pilots a structured, reproducible signal fusion approach that combines business, technical, and operational metrics into one prioritized output.
scope: Deliverables: scoring rubric, data ingestion spec, prototype watchlist dashboard, and 8-week runbook for continuous capture. Out of scope: full automation of onboarding or SLA changes. This probe focuses on North America + EU signals and mid-market customer usage patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric doc with >=8 signals defined (technical, commercial, availability, legal, customer telemetry)

Automated pipeline ingesting at least 3 public sources (model releases RSS, GitHub tags, vendor pricing pages) and 2 internal sources (telemetry alert feed, contract register) into a staged sheet or dataset
Prototype dashboard in Metabase or internal console showing top 25 emergent models by prospectivity score, filterable by region and vertical
One-page ops playbook describing frequency of re-ranking, ownership, and escalation rules
Stakeholder signoff from PM, Research, and SRE on rationale and initial watchlist
